modified_caption: Performance of various documentation resources across increasing token chunk sizes. The line plot depicts how different resources respond to changes in the number of tokens, with the x-axis labeled 'Number of Tokens' ranging from 200 to 1000 in increments of 200, and the y-axis representing performance metrics from 10 to 40 in increments of 10. Four resources are compared: Tutorials (blue line), Library Documentation (red line), StackOverflow posts (yellow line), and Github files (green line). Tutorials exhibit a gradual increase in performance, starting at approximately 23 at 200 tokens and stabilizing around 30 at 800 tokens. Library Documentation initially rises from 28 at 200 tokens to a peak of 35 at 500 tokens before declining sharply to 20 by 1000 tokens. StackOverflow posts demonstrate a consistent decline, beginning at 32 and dropping steadily to 12 by 1000 tokens. Github files, however, show a robust upward trend, starting at 29 and reaching a peak of 35 at 800 tokens before slightly tapering off. Notably, Github files consistently outperform all other resources beyond 400 tokens, while Library Documentation initially surpasses Tutorials but is eventually overtaken as token size increases.

modifications.claim: Library Documentation peaks at 35 at 500 tokens before declining sharply to 20 by 1000 tokens.
modifications.reality: Library Documentation actually peaks at approximately 32 at 500 tokens and declines to around 27 at 800 tokens, not 20 at 1000 tokens. The value and rate of decline are misrepresented.

modifications.claim: Github files reach a peak of 35 at 800 tokens.
modifications.reality: Github files peak at approximately 32 at 800 tokens, not 35. The value is inflated by about 10%.

modifications.claim: Github files consistently outperform all other resources beyond 400 tokens.
modifications.reality: Github files do not consistently outperform all other resources beyond 400 tokens; they intersect with Library Documentation at around 500 tokens and remain close to Tutorials and Library Documentation thereafter. The comparison is exaggerated.

modifications.claim: Library Documentation declines sharply to 20 by 1000 tokens.
modifications.reality: The plot does not extend to 1000 tokens for Library Documentation, and the decline is not sharp; it tapers to about 27 at 800 tokens. The trend characterization is misleading.
